items.title: Bill Bourgeois Interview, 1959-12-10
items.q: Yeah I played quite a bit with Pansy Lane in those days.

ctx.x: You mentioned Pansy Lane out there.

Yeah I played quite a bit with Pansy Lane in those days. We used to play on Esplanade Avenue, there was a place called the Eagles home. We used to play there every Saturday. And the band was up on the platform right under a tin roof. And you talk about loud, and Pansy never did play soft, you see. And none of the band played soft. Boy it used to ring so loud you couldn't hear yourself think, you know. And the only one I remember in that band was Chink Martin's brother who played bass. Bill Abraham, William…
